newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down as most engineering scrips fell on profit taking by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 30.55 points or 1.67 percent at 1,493.12 on a turnover of 90.6 million taka. Friday is Moslem weekend. Losers led gainers by 120 to 38.

"Majority shares lost on profit-taking after they gained in the past week on news that commercial banks will double credit to investors. The market sentiment is positive," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps lost 323 taka to 5,978, Amam Sea Food shed 17 to 4,381 and ACI Limited was up 5.47 to 169.79.
